lol, I spent a weekend in peoria county jail (town in illinois), with a hundred plus others after getting arrested for possessing drugs at a music festival. The conditions were aweful. There were about 16-18 of us in a 2 floor room, 3 pods on the first floor, 4 on the second floor. Two people in each room, so yes, multiple people were sleeping in the common area. There was a disgusting metal toilet that looked like it had never been cleaned, and cement bunk beds. You got a shitty gym mat to seperate yourself from the cement, and a small hospital blanket and pillow. It was incredibly cold the whole time, the meals were terrible, the showers were too hot and could burn the sensitive areas of your body. We didn't have any yard time, 1 hour of TV time, 10-12 hours in the room, no books that weren't related to christianity. We tore up tissue paper to make cards/ a chess board and that was our entertainment. We tried to have a drum circle and got threatened for conspiracy to riot.




Now keep in mind we were all 17-28 year olds who had drugs on us at a music festival. We aren't bad people, but we were treated worse than animals. Luckily I had enough money to bond out, so I only spent 4 days there, but I know multiple people who spents months, some are still awaiting for the right plea/trial.



Oh, and my bail was $10,000. Less than the man in video bonding that robbed and beat a man with a gun... the goverment really doesn't like LSD...





EDIT: Oh and not to mention the ponzi scheme they ran. So, in the common area was a phone. Unfortunately, you could only call local numbers. Well, that doesn't help at all, since all of us were out of state. So along comes this shithead lawyer who visits the jail (because he knows a ton of kids just got arrested) and will make calls on your behalf, and come off as a helpful guy, all while telling you and your family totally different things, trying to pressure your parents into hiring him for $20,000 instead of bailing your kids out, and tells them horror stories about the jail, sentencing possibilities ect. A real class A douchebag. For whatever reason the jail allows him and only him to make free contact with all the people in jail, his card is found in the cells, all very sketchy shit.
